description_en: Triggers a job to immediately run once
description_zh: 触发一次任务立即运行
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 execute-job --job-id 92583 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteJob

parameters.help_en: The job ID. You can obtain the job ID on the Task Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The parameters that are passed to trigger the job to run. The input value can be a random string. The parameters that are passed are obtained by calling the `context.getInstanceParameters()` class in the `processor` code. The parameters are different from custom parameters for creating jobs
parameters.help_zh: 本次触发携带参数，可以是任意字符串，`processor`代码通过`context.getInstanceParameters()`获取，区别于创建任务自定义参数
parameters.name: instance_parameters

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to check the job status. Valid values: -true: The job can be run only if the job is enabled. -false: The job can be run even if the job is disabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否检查任务状态，取值如下：true：任务启用才能执行任务。false：任务不启用也可以执行任务
parameters.name: check_job_status

parameters.help_en: The type of the designated machine. Valid values: -1: worker. -2: label
parameters.help_zh: 指定机器的类型，取值如下：1：指定worker。2：指定label
parameters.name: designate_type

parameters.help_en: The worker address of the application. To query the worker address, call the GetWokerList operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用的worker地址，需要先通过GetWokerList接口返回workerAddress
parameters.name: worker

Data.description_en: The ID of the job instance that is returned if the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 如果成功，会返回任务实例ID

Message.description_en: The error message that is returned only if the corresponding error occurs
Message.description_zh: 错误消息，仅出错时返回错误信息
Message.example: groupid not exist groupId: testSchedulerx.defaultGroup namespace: adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc****

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`
`false`
Success.description_zh:
触发任务是否成功。取值如下：

`true`：触发任务成功。
`false`：触发任务失败
